name: [Forward Alliance] Channel Name Restrictions
description: Allows only admins to create channels whose display name or handle starts with configured prefixes.

settings_schema.header: Restrict sensitive channel name prefixes to admins only.
settings_schema.footer: Mattermost only exposes a post-create hook for channels, so blocked channels are deleted immediately after creation.

settings.help_text: Comma, semicolon, or newline-separated prefixes matched against the display name and URL handle. Matching is case-insensitive.
Message shown to non-admins when the plugin removes a channel created with a restricted prefix.
settings.default: Only admins can create channels whose name starts with a restricted prefix.
